business_summary: AUTOWAVE Co., Ltd. engages in the automotive-related businesses in Japan. The company offers tires and wheels, vehicle inspection and maintenance, sheet metal and scratch repair, oil changes, regular replacement parts, battery, and other car supplies. It also offers car navigation, rear monitor, backup camera, and electronic toll collection system. In addition, the company sells and installs speakers, woofers, and power amplifiers. Further, it provides body coat, car film, window glass water repellent coat, wheel coat, headlight coat, and safety products, as well as purchases and sells new and used cars. AUTOWAVE Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1960 and is headquartered in Chiba, Japan.
